title: Rural Home Loans Returned-Payment Fee Amount
content:
**Clause.** The returned-payment fee on a Rural Home Loans loan is the product's returned payment fee for each returned remittance, and nothing when the return reason is unauthorized. The fee is stated in USD to the cent.

## Restated by return reason

| Bank's return reason | Fee for the returned remittance |
|---|---|
| unauthorized | nothing |
| any other reason | the product's returned payment fee, from the product's schedule of fees and charges |

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

Suppose a product whose returned payment fee were 30.00 USD.

- A monthly remittance of 1941.20 returned for insufficient funds: one fee of 30.00.
- The same remittance returned as unauthorized: no fee.
- Two remittances returned in different months, each for a reason other than unauthorized: one fee of 30.00 for each, 60.00 in all.

## Basis Q&A

**Is the fee charged per return entry or per remittance?** Per returned remittance; the interest, principal and escrow return entries of one remittance carry one fee between them.
